∀ {p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred} {d : Minidregg.Pred.Sat.DiffProblem} {c : Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Certificate}, p.difference? = Option.some d → d.decide = Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Verdict.unsat c → ∀ (o n : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval p o n = Bool.false

∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {cap : ℕ} {a b ss : List Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Sys}, Minidregg.Pred.Sat.product cap a b = Option.some ss → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n a → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n b → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n ss
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {l : List Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Sys}, Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n l → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n (Minidregg.Pred.Sat.prune l)

∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {cap : ℕ} {a b ss : List Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Sys}, Minidregg.Pred.Sat.union cap a b = Option.some ss → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n a ∨ Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n b → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Covered o n ss
∀ {d : Minidregg.Pred.Sat.DiffProblem} {c : Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Certificate}, d.decide = Minidregg.Pred.Sat.Verdict.unsat c → Minidregg.Pred.Sat.checkAll d.systems c = Bool.true
